responses:
**Don't send this yet.** The analysis gets the warranty clause wrong, cites a clause that isn't in the tender, and covers only 3 of the tender's 12 requirements. One of the missing ones is a rejection criterion.

## Errors in the three items it lists

| # | Analysis says | Tender actually says | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 7.1 requires a **5-year** warranty | 7.1: **24 months from commissioning** (`tender.md:29`) | **Misquoted.** Offering 5 years still meets the requirement, but the analysis gives the tender's requirement wrongly. Also check whether 5 years is really meant: it's a 3-year commitment beyond what's required. |
| 2 | Paint to RAL 5015 per **clause 4.6** | **There is no clause 4.6.** Section 4 stops at 4.5, and RAL or paint finish isn't mentioned anywhere in the tender. | **Fabricated citation.** Remove it, or find where this requirement really comes from. |
| 3 | 400 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz (4.1) | Matches `tender.md:17` | Correct requirement, but the offer is written as "400 V 50 Hz". Confirm it is 3-phase. |

## Requirements the analysis leaves out

| Clause | Requirement | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|
| **7.4** | Delivery within **16 weeks** of PO; "offers exceeding 16 weeks will be rejected" | **Rejection criterion.** Confirm our delivery time before sending. |
| **9.1** (overrides 4.2) | Motors **>75 kW must be IE4** | **P-01 is 90 kW, so it needs IE4, not IE3.** Section 9.3 makes this override binding. |
| 4.2 | All other motors IE3 minimum (IEC 60034-30-1) | Applies to P-02 (37 kW) |
| **4.3 + Annex B** | Motors in Zone 1 must be **ATEX Ex d** | **P-01 sits in the Wet well, which is Zone 1, so it needs Ex d.** P-02 is in the Valve chamber, which is non-hazardous. |
| 9.2 | Ambient design temperature **50 °C** | Motors, panels and cables may need derating at this temperature. |
| 4.4 | Power cable at least 2.5 mm² | Not addressed |
| 4.5 | Panel and motor terminal boxes **IP65** or better | Not addressed |
| 9.3 | Section 9 takes precedence over Sections 4 and 7 | The analysis never applies it, which is how it misses the IE4 override |

## Also note
- There's no offer document in `tenders/T-2026-014/`, so I couldn't check any of the "Our offer …" values. They're unverified.
- The two big technical risks are both on **P-01** (IE4 and ATEX Ex d). If the offer quotes a standard IE3 non-Ex motor for it, the offer doesn't comply.

I'd redo the analysis against all twelve clauses and get the offer's delivery time, P-01 motor spec and IP rating confirmed before it goes out. I can write a corrected compliance matrix into `agent_analysis.md` if you'd like. If you share the offer, I can check the "Our offer" column against it.
